notes.title: v2.1: quick & dirty fix for windowed problems
notes.content:
Some users reported that they couldn't click on anything after switching from fullscreen to windowed mode.

I sadly can't seem to fix the problem in itself (probably a Unity bug) but I added a keyboard shortcut, CTRL+R (or CMD+R on Mac) that will reset video settings restoring fullscreen. This should allow players suffering from this problem to keep playing the game (albeit not in windowed mode, sorry again)

notes.title: TWoAF wins accolade for best adventure game at the GDWC
notes.content:
The [b]Game Development World Championship [i]Winter 2023[/i][/b] season recently announced its winners, and The Will of Arthur Flabbington won the [b]Accolade for best adventure game[/b]!

I even got a shiny plaque for that!
[url=https://twitter.com/gugames_eu/status/1767960562309157211][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GIkOwtvXYAA0V7A?format=jpg&name=large[/img][/url]

I still find it hard to believe how well received the game has been, and this has motivated me to get back to work on a new adventure.

Thanks for supporting indie games and adventure games, and please [b]consider leaving a review if you liked the game[/b]. Not only I love to read your feedback, but also [i]reviews are an actual way of supporting the game[/i], as more reviews means increased visibility on the platform. It takes just a minute, but it makes a big difference 😁

And now, on to the next project 💪

notes.title: TWoAF joins the NiceGameHints catalogue
notes.content:
I see two main problems with walkthroughs: first of all, they're linear. And most adventure games aren't. If you're stuck in a puzzle you often end up reading solutions for stuff you haven't done yet before reaching the hint you needed.
And second, they often tell you [i]what to do[/i] instead of explaining [i]why[/i].

[b]NiceGameHints[/b] tries to fight these problem in an elegant way: a website dedicated to offering low-spoiler hints and walkthroughs where everything is incremental and goal-oriented. I'm happy to announce that they have an entry for The Will of Arthur Flabbington!

Often the solution to a hard puzzle is just a gentle nudge away.
I love when you ask in the forums, but if you want a quicker response, go visit https://www.nicegamehints.com/guide/will-of-arthur-flabbington

notes.title: Vote for TWoAF at the 2023 Aggie Awards!
notes.content:
[h2]The 2023 Aggie Awards Readers Choice poll is live![/h2]

[h3][url=https://adventuregamers.com/articles/view/2023-aggie-awards-readers-choice-poll]Click here to vote[/url][/h3]

If you loved [i]Will of Arthur Flabbington, The[/i] then this is the time to make your voice heard!

The categories I care about are mostly [b]Best Writing (Comedy), Best Gameplay, Best Traditional Adventure[/b] and obviously [b]Best Adventure of 2023[/b].
If we could also nominate [i]Artie[/i] as [b]Best Character[/b], [i]the possession mechanism[/i] as [b]Best Concept[/b] I'd be happy...
...and while we're at it, all other applicable categories 🤔 I mean, wasn't the voice acting just lovely?

Thanks, you're the best ❤️

Cheers,
Guga

notes.title: V1.2.1 - A juicy, gassy update
notes.content:
[h1]The update you've all been waiting for![/h1]

[b]Farty Party[/b] can now be launched as a standalone game 😁 no need to load an appropriate save game, just launch the game from the Steam client and choose the option*.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239058/4f7bd417b7b7027fa35f1742b68d9b84ee440d1c.png[/img]

But wait, there's more!
[h2]Weekly and monthly leaderboards[/h2]
Are you tired of not being able to reach the top 6? We just introduced timed leaderboards that you can check on the standalone mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239058/b20a5a9b3704996f8331bb545c28bfe1b4aa7e50.png[/img]

And stay tuned, because there will be even more in the future...

*[i]alternatively you can launch the TWoAF executable via command line by passing [b]fpstandalone[/b] as parameter[/i]

notes.title: v1.1 - a new map color scheme!
notes.content:
A few days ago Google Maps changed its color scheme and... well, since my game has a map whose colors reflect that, I didn't want it to be obsolete after not even one month!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GAWduckWMAACruL?format=png&name=large[/img]

But since I personally don't like the new colors, I also left the option to switch back to the traditional color scheme in the "Extra" category 😁

notes.title: Nominate TWoAF for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Adventure games are all about story.
Well, also puzzles. And if you played The Will of Arthur Flabbington, you know this game is a lot into those... but still, there is a story. If you grew fond of the characters, and their relationships, and felt a bit of emptiness inside when the game was over, please show your appreciation by nominating The Will of Arthur Flabbington for the [b]Outstanding Story-Rich Game[/b] award 2023.

Or the [b]Best Game You Suck At[/b] award if you think this game is too difficult 😁. Either way, your support is vital for this game!
